task.goal: A binary RPC server receives 4-byte big-endian length-prefixed messages in arbitrary chunks. FrameDecoder.feed currently parses each chunk independently and can lose a partial prefix or body; it also accepts frames larger than max_size. Fix FrameDecoder in framing.py so feed returns only complete frames, keeps partial bytes for later calls, handles several frames per chunk, rejects oversized lengths before buffering the body, and can continue after a complete frame. Run tests and validate.
